name: Yamazoe (Japan)
description: A green field charged at the centre with the Yamazoe village emblem in white: a stylised device of a loop, horizontal strokes and a hooked end.
history: Municipal flag of Yamazoe, a village in Nara Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. Flag and emblem were adopted on 1 April 1972.

features.role: Yamazoe village emblem — a stylised device of a loop, horizontal strokes and a hooked end
